cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Hope with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Help me choose celebration glasses for when our café application gets approved. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're on the waiting list. I haven't even told my mum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then just believe it with me here. Which glasses belong in our café?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: These two. Mum would insist on a mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose her mug too. You just pictured our first customer.

mechanism: A leads imagined cafe preparations while conceding privacy and no spending so B joins hope despite an unapproved application.
confusable: Unlike assuming approval is already granted, A recruits a tentative shared picture; borrowed authority lowers practical commitment to retain B cooperation.
comparison: Private choosing of future cafe crockery differs from publicly finding a parade audience.
seedUse: Use D103-b waiting list/glasses/Mum mug with S02-b reducing the demanded participation while maintaining direction.
